reviews.text: Perfect! Superb treatment, they sent us videos and updates every day and were very helpful, we will definitely be back.
Fabio top

We've left our cat, Fernanda, on several occasions; the staff is always very welcoming, kind, and helpful. The spaces are spacious, clean, and well-maintained, and photo/video updates are frequent. The cat is always welcomed and cared for with great attention and dedication, with an initial personalized welcome in a private suite (to allow her to settle in). Living in an apartment, she has the opportunity to interact with other cats and have more space.
It's a service we highly recommend :)

My partner and I left our cat Giannino at this shelter for about 12 days, and I have to say we had a wonderful time. The spaces were spacious, clean, with toys and shelves to allow the cats to roam and run around peacefully.
Every two days, they sent us news, photos, or videos of our cat via WhatsApp.
Before accepting him, they required us to revaccinate him and give him a flea treatment.
What can I say? Super!

Hi Jacopo, thanks for the 5⭐, we really appreciate it!
A cuddle for Turbo ❤️
See you soon 😺🐾
 …

A truly positive experience! ❤️ I left my cat Luna for three weeks for the first time, and although she needed a few extra days to settle in, being older and unaccustomed to being outside, everything went very well. I'm truly happy and satisfied with how she was cared for, and I can't recommend this team of professionals enough!

I entrusted my cat Mimmi to Miciottello for three weeks (it was her first time away from home for such a long time) and I couldn't have made a better choice! ✨
Despite the newness and Mimmi's somewhat "unique" personality, thanks to the team's attention, Mimmi adapted in just a few days, appearing calm and perfectly at ease. The facility is wonderful: immaculately clean, meticulously maintained, and with large, bright, and stimulating spaces!
Communication was impeccable: they made me feel completely at ease from the first moment, and I was constantly updated with videos of Mimmi.
The entire team's passion and professionalism are truly evident, and Miciottello has become Mimmi's absolute go-to! Thank you so much to Fabio and Carola for caring for her as if she were your own. Highly recommended to anyone looking for the best for their cat. ❤️ (Greetings and thanks from Mimmi too! ✨)

We left our kitten Nina at Miciottello for three weeks. It was the first time we'd left our cat for such a long time, and we were saddened. Nina had never seen a kitten before, but to her great surprise, she settled in beautifully, interacting with all the little guests at Miciottello. Fabio, Carola, and Alessia carefully and, above all, with the utmost professionalism. Each kitten is gradually introduced to the facility in dedicated suites, thus avoiding any trauma. The spaces are enormous and meticulously maintained. Scratching posts are everywhere, and there are games of skill. Each space is connected to the other, so each kitten can roam freely (in a protected environment) on a walkable surface that rivals Gardaland. The air conditioning is always on, and quality food is available. Regular updates with photos and/or videos are provided. We wanted to give Nina a great gift, and instead, Fabio, Carola, and Alessia gave us one!

I left my cat, Teddy, at Miciottello for three weeks, and I couldn't have made a better choice!
A fantastic, well-maintained, and welcoming facility, where I immediately sensed great professionalism and love for animals. One thing I really appreciated was the constant updates: receiving photos and videos of Teddy during his stay reassured me and allowed me to always feel close to him, even from a distance.
Teddy had a wonderful time, and I left feeling calm, knowing I'd entrusted him to truly caring and attentive people.
I highly recommend Miciottello to anyone looking for a safe, loving, and professional place for their cat!
We brought our cat for the summer holidays. We had a great time! The place is huge and very well organized. The staff are very knowledgeable, helpful, and kind. Highly recommended.

Highly recommended. I admit I was afraid to leave my cat, but Fabio, Carola, and Alessia were able to create a tailor-made environment for every feline need!
Plus, when I returned, Mino (my cat) was calm and serene, and much sweeter!
If you're traveling and don't know who to entrust your cat to: Miciottello is the perfect place!

The entire staff was professional, kind, and very attentive. We also greatly appreciated the update videos during our cattery's stay, which allowed us to relax and feel close to him even from a distance.

A heartfelt thank you to all the staff at Miciottello! We will definitely be back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and loving cattery for their cat. ❤️
Special people who know how to care for cats with professionalism and kindness. Highly recommended ❤️

I entrusted my 17-year-old cat to Miciottello for two weeks, and I couldn't have made a better choice.
The extremely kind and competent staff took great care of her, allowing me to spend my vacation in complete peace.
The facility is brand new, very bright, and equipped with all the comforts, such as water fountains, toys, and air conditioning.
Miciottello was a wonderful discovery, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a safe and welcoming place to entrust their cat! 😻

The facility is brand new, beautiful, spacious, and clean. The staff were incredibly kind and sweet, and kept us updated almost daily with photos and videos. It was our first time leaving our cat in a shelter, and we had a great time: we'll definitely bring her back. Thank you so much!

We left our cat for 10 days and had a great time! The facility is beautiful, spacious, spotlessly clean, and full of toys. The staff is incredibly kind and kept us updated, making us feel at ease. Our cat had a wonderful time and can't wait to come back! Highly recommended! ❤️🐱 …

The facility is beautiful and well-organized. I found the staff to be particularly attentive and caring, respecting Rocky's schedule and needs to ensure she was fully adapted and keeping me updated.
Highly recommended!!

After a two-week stay, I found Maui to be relaxed and comfortable. The spaces were carefully furnished, beautiful, and clean. Constant messages were received throughout the stay with photos and videos. The facility was very well organized, and the staff was friendly and helpful. Many thanks to Carola and Fabio!
With patience and professionalism, you managed to "flush out" my Clark, a total shy guy. Thank you so much.
Thank you so much. Daily communication is possible with photos and videos. I'd like to point out that the place is very clean and spacious. I highly recommend it.
Thanks for the 5 stars❤️
